stock.description: EPS Creative Health Technology Group Limited functions as an investment holding company with diverse operations. It specializes in comprehensive apparel supply chain management, serving clients across Hong Kong, mainland China, Japan, the United States, Europe, and other global markets. The company's activities are divided into two main segments: Garment and Healthcare. Within its Garment division, EPS Creative Health delivers end-to-end supply chain solutions for various knitwear products, including women's, men's, and children's apparel. These services encompass everything from initial fashion trend analysis and product conceptualization to material sourcing, meticulous production oversight, stringent quality control, and efficient logistics. Its clientele primarily comprises owners and sourcing agents of apparel retail brands. Concurrently, the Healthcare segment focuses on the development of novel pharmaceuticals, offers innovative research organization (IRO) services, and provides expert medical consultancy. The group also handles general client account management and related support services. Established in 1999 and headquartered in Hung Hom, Hong Kong, the company was formerly known as Speed Apparel Holding Limited before officially adopting its current name in August 2021. EPS Creative Health Technology Group Limited operates as a subsidiary of EPS Holdings, Inc.
